raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "live in"
  role subject "Min-jun"
  role location "Ploiești"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "be allergic to"
  role subject "Rachel Clarke"
  role object "bee stings"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "be allergic to"
  role subject "Karim"
  role object "lactose"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "teach"
  role subject "Lucian Constantinescu"
  role object "drawing"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s5 stated
  relation "report to"
  role subject "Aiko"
  role object "Yan"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s6 stated
  relation "report to"
  role subject "Jürgen"
  role object "Alejandro"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?l
  where match
    relation "be based in"
    role subject "Aurelia"
    role location ?l
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "attend"
    role subject ?x
    role object "the product launch"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  except ?x "Silviu Ardeleanu"

@q3 query
  select ?t
  measure start
  measure end
  where match
    relation "report to"
    role subject "Mr Hughes"
    role object "Théo"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q4 query
  where match
    relation "fly to"
    role subject "Dimitra Nikolaidis"
    role destination "Sibiu"
    polarity negated
  end

@q5 query
  mode explain
  where match
    relation "be closed"
    role subject "the Cahul Arena"
    polarity affirmed
  end
